card.title: PlayStation 4 Blu-ray Motor Driver & Drive Controller Diagnostic

claims.statement: The BD7764MUV is the Blu-ray motor driver IC on the PlayStation 4 mainboard.
claims.evidence: Diode and voltage measurements mapped around the BD7764MUV motor driver circuit.

claims.statement: The drive controller chip orchestrates the entire operation of the Blu-ray drive.
claims.evidence: Pinout measurements documented across the drive controller.
claims.quote: This chip orchestrates the entire operation of the blu-ray drive

claims.statement: Error CE-35888-2 typically indicates a Renesas IC problem in the disc drive which is not repairable.
claims.evidence: Error code correlation given in documentation.
claims.quote: Encountering this error typically indicates a Renesas IC problem, which is not repairable.

procedure: Check the Blu-ray circuit for missing or damaged components if the drive is not accepting discs.
Inspect for blown fuses near the Blu-ray circuit.
Attempt to replace the disc drive if error CE-35888-2 appears after updating the console.
card.caveats: Always verify board revisions as layout specifics can differ across PS4 models.
